en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an urban square with several electric trams, cobblestone pavement, and late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings. In the background a steel suspension bridge is visible. The title text in red Gothic-style lettering reads "Gruss aus Blasewitz." and "Schillerplatz." The publisher credit appears at the bottom, also in red, mentioning Blasewitz. The tram in the center bears route signage and the number 209.
